findings.text: measure_run and the _call_wrote_log join at :389 produce every figure and are fixed by this commit, yet no executed check exercises either; _report_detector at :797 tests only _is_gate_command, so a regression that re-charged a gate reached through a shell variable, or mis-set the share, would promote green — a test that fails on the reinstated double-count is missing.
